name: Motion → Calibrate Level
description: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) computes a calibration matrix so that the current accelerometer reading maps to `[0, 0, 1]` (device flat, Z pointing up). Place the device on a level surface and trigger this action. It replaces the current `transform_matrix`.

config_entries.label: Save
config_entries.description: Save the resulting matrix to NVS flash so it is automatically restored on the next boot. Defaults to `false`.
